cohort: A 25-year-old pregnant patient at 29 weeks gestation experiencing asthenia, vomiting, and weight loss.
finding: A 25-year-old pregnant patient at 29 weeks gestation was diagnosed with diffuse gastric cancer (carcinoma with signet ring, undifferentiated type) which metastasized, leading to pregnancy interruption at 34 weeks and subsequent chemotherapy.
mod_finding: Pregnancy was interrupted via abdominal delivery (cesarean section) at 34 weeks gestation due to the diagnosis of diffuse gastric cancer.
